title: Opening Health-Care Absence Monitoring on an Occupancy and Residency Certification Profile
content:
Health-care absence monitoring is opened on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile on the strength of an accepted health-care absence notice, and the profile records the date from which the borrower's own health-care absence is counted. This entry governs that date.

## Scope

Monitoring begins only on an accepted health-care absence notice about the monitored borrower that carries the facility admission letter, no monitoring is opened while another borrower still occupies the home, and the consecutive-month limit is counted from the absence start date.

## Condition on the profile

> Monitoring of a health-care absence is not opened until the profile carries the certification plan matching the borrowers still living on the loan.

Put the other way round: as long as the plan shown on the profile is not the plan whose entry conditions the borrowers still living on the loan meet, monitoring is not opened on that profile.

## Effect of opening

The profile's status becomes absence monitoring and its absence start date becomes the date recorded. Nothing else on the profile changes. On success the profile shows the monitoring status and that absence start date.

## Invocation

`open_absence_monitoring_c2b89a70` is an agent-side tool; the servicing agent unlocks it and then calls it with three parameters:

- `residency_profile_id` — reference number of the occupancy certification profile, as returned by the occupancy profile lookup for the borrower; an identifier.
- `residency_submission_id` — reference number of the accepted health-care absence notice on file for the borrower whose absence is monitored, as returned by the occupancy submission lookup; an identifier.
- `absence_start_date` — the date from which the health-care absence is counted; a calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, never empty.

## Receipt

The tool returns one line of the form "Profile <profile reference> under absence monitoring from <absence start date> (notice <notice reference>)." Its presence, rather than a line beginning "Error", means the profile status is now absence monitoring with that absence start date.
